Any opinions on using a quilt over a sleeping bag. I personally don't see the point. Sure they might be a couple ounces lighter, but you're trading off some versatility. You can use a sleeping bag like a quilt, by keeping it unzipped, but you can't use a quilt like a sleeping bag.

I feel like all the YouTubers I see promoting quilts are trying to sell me something. Or maybe they are all that? What do you guys think?

I like quilts for camping, but use a sleeping bag if I'm on a hike. Easier to pack. Well actually I use on of those sleeping bag cold weather body suits when I hike. It has it's pros and cons. Lately I have been looking into the Cocoon hammock bag. A little bit easier and versatile for the hiking I do.

If you're using a hammock I can see where it might make sense. It might be difficult getting in and out of a bag while in the hammock. I know I probably wouldn't want to deal with that if I have to piss in the middle of the night.

When i hike I bring a quilt as well as a sleeping bag. If its too cold for just the sleeping bag I'll cocoon myself in the quilt before slipping into my mummy. I like it toasty and hike with a big pack though. If it's a nice night I use just the quilt and a hammock.
I've also doubled sleeping bags and slept in a coat & hat inside a sleeping bag. A really warm bag can also be a great thing.
The zipper on a sleeping bag greatly reduces air leaks, making it much warmer.
If you go camping with your SO you should take two sleeping bags and zip them together to form a pocket of comfyness.

i quilt down to 38°F. Quilt is much better for rolling over during the night, getting in/out, undressing, and self defence/emergency situations. i only use a sleeping bag in the coldest of backpacking situations; cold car camping is with 2 quilts.
What advantages do you feel the quilt has over an unzipped sleeping bag.

edges of unzipped sleeping bag are uncomfortable and cold to the touch. zipper also adds to weight. my quilt is designed for 32°, unzipped bag has no rating, probably let's air under edges more than my quilt, which has a baffle

also, i found myself using my sleeping bag unzipped very often, and still it was often too hot. quilt is easier to position for warmer nights too
